title: Korea Investment Savings Bank says abnormal external transactions on its mobile homepage leaked data of 8만6433 customers
date_note: Money Today (25 Nov) relays the bank's announcement of 25 Nov; the page dates the abnormal activity to 22-23 Nov, discovered 23 Nov.
geo_basis: country named in the source; no city given, pin at Seoul
summary: Money Today reports that Korea Investment Savings Bank said on 25 November that abnormal external transactions on its mobile homepage between 22:42 on 22 November and 03:35 on 23 November leaked some customers' personal data, listing name, date of birth, gender, phone number and CI. It gives 8만6433 customers; Hankyung says 178 more were added, for 8만6611 in total.
plain: Korea Investment Savings Bank says abnormal outside transactions on its mobile site leaked customer data. Money Today gives 8만6433 customers; Hankyung says 178 more were added, for 8만6611 in total.
exec: A Korean savings bank says customer data leaked through its mobile homepage; Hankyung reports 8만6611 customers in total.

evidence.quote: 지난 23일 시스템 점검 중 22일 22시42분부터 23일 03시35분 사이 당행 모바일 홈페이지에 대한 외부 비정상 거래로 일부 고객의 개인정보가 유출됐음을 확인했다

validation.note: Two independent publishers, Money Today and Hankyung (Korea Economic Daily), each report the leak and the bank's statement; Hankyung gives the later total of 8만6611. The bank's own notice was not read.

review.note: window, 8만6433 and 8만6611/178 figures, data items vs Money Today and Hankyung
